description: SQLite Integration for Emm Script - Convert from file-based tracking to database management

tasks.title: Create features table
tasks.description: As a developer, I need a features table to store feature markdown content.
acceptanceCriteria: Create features table with columns: id, content, hash, name, created_at
Add foreign key constraint from sessions.feature_id to features.id

tasks.title: Create sessions table
tasks.description: As a developer, I need a sessions table to track emm execution sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create sessions table with columns: id, feature_id, max_iterations, tool, status, created_at, completed_at, total_iterations, total_tasks, completed_tasks

tasks.title: Create tasks table
tasks.description: As a developer, I need a tasks table to store extracted tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create tasks table with columns: id, session_id, branch_name, task_id, title, description, acceptance_criteria, status, started_at, completed_at
Add foreign key constraint from tasks.session_id to sessions.id

tasks.title: Create iterations table
tasks.description: As a developer, I need an iterations table to track each emm iteration.
acceptanceCriteria: Create iterations table with columns: id, session_id, iteration_number, task_id_worked_on, status, started_at, completed_at, opencode_output, opencode_stderr
Add foreign key constraint from iterations.session_id to sessions.id

tasks.title: Create console_logs table
tasks.description: As a developer, I need a console_logs table for audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Create console_logs table with columns: id, session_id, iteration_number, log_level, component, message, created_at
Add foreign key constraint from console_logs.session_id to sessions.id

tasks.title: Add database indexes
tasks.description: As a developer, I need indexes for common query patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Create index idx_tasks_session_status on tasks(session_id, status)
Create index idx_iterations_session on iterations(session_id, iteration_number)

tasks.title: Create EmmDatabase class skeleton
tasks.description: As a developer, I need a database class with initialization.
acceptanceCriteria: Add EmmDatabase class with __init__(self, db_path: str)
Add initialize_database(self) method that creates all tables and indexes
Database file created at specified path

tasks.title: Add create_feature method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to save feature files to the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Add create_feature(self, feature_path: str) -> int method

tasks.title: Add get_feature method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to retrieve features from the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_feature(self, feature_id: int) -> dict method

tasks.title: Add create_session method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to create new sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add create_session(self, feature_id: int, max_iterations: int) -> int method
Insert into sessions table with status='running'

tasks.title: Add get_session method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to retrieve session data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_session(self, session_id: int) -> dict method

tasks.title: Add update_session_status method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to update session status.
acceptanceCriteria: Add update_session_status(self, session_id: int, status: str) -> None method
Set completed_at timestamp if status is 'completed' or 'failed'

tasks.title: Add create_task method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to save tasks to the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Add create_task(self, session_id: int, task: dict) -> None method
Convert acceptance_criteria list to JSON string

tasks.title: Add get_next_task method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to get the next pending task.
acceptanceCriteria: Add get_next_task(self, session_id: int) -> Optional[dict] method
Query tasks where session_id matches and status='pending'

tasks.title: Add update_task_status method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to update task status.
acceptanceCriteria: Add update_task_status(self, session_id: int, task_id: str, status: str) -> None method
Set started_at timestamp if status changes to 'in_progress'
Set completed_at timestamp if status changes to 'completed'

tasks.title: Add create_iteration method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to record when iterations start.
acceptanceCriteria: Add create_iteration(self, session_id: int, iteration_number: int, task_id: str) -> int method
Insert into iterations table with status='running'

tasks.title: Add update_iteration method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to save iteration outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add update_iteration(self, iteration_id: int, output: str, stderr: str) -> None method
Update iterations table with opencode_output, opencode_stderr, completed_at

tasks.title: Add log_message method
tasks.description: As a developer, I need to log console messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Add log_message(self, session_id: int, iteration_number: int, level: str, component: str, message: str) -> None method
